tools.name: analyze_component
tools.description:
[session] Static a11y + UX analysis of one component's source (HTML/JSX/Vue/Svelte/Angular). No browser, no network. Best for pre-commit feedback on a snippet.
vs audit_repo: scans the whole codebase tree. vs audit_url: runs the full rule engine on a live page.

tools.name: audit_a11y
tools.description: [a11y] Multi-engine a11y audit on a URL (axe-core + AccessLint + VertaaUX analyzers). Returns normalised WCAG findings with machine-actionable fix suggestions. Set baseline_name to save for later diff_a11y.

tools.name: audit_artifact
tools.description:
[audit] Audit a captured browser artifact instead of a live URL. Use for CI-run debugging or customer bug reports without re-running the browser.
Supports: har (response times, failures, payloads, security headers), lighthouse (a11y + perf JSON). playwright-trace returns INVALID_PARAMS, use audit_url.

tools.name: audit_repo
tools.description: [audit] Static UX + a11y scan of a local codebase tree (React/Vue/Svelte components, HTML templates). Detects missing alt text, unlabeled buttons/inputs/links, placeholder labels. For live pages use audit_url.

tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: [audit] Run a full UX + a11y audit on a live URL. Returns top 5 issues + scores; use get_findings for the full list. Offline mode (localhost/file://) is static-only.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: [session] Capture a hosted screenshot of a URL plus the full audit result. CONSUMES 1 audit quota, implemented via audit_url under the hood, not a lightweight headless snapshot. Use mode='basic' for cheapest. Hints (viewport, fullPage, highlightIssues, waitForSelector) are advisory.

tools.name: compare_competitors
tools.description:
[session] Audit your site vs N competitor URLs in parallel, return side-by-side scores + top-5 differentiators with optional industry benchmarks. Best for positioning, pitch decks, quarterly scans.
vs diff_audits: that compares two existing audit IDs (free); this runs N+1 fresh audits (consumes N+1 quota).

tools.name: create_pr_comment
tools.description:
[pr] Generate a PER-FILE GitHub PR comment with in-line `gh pr suggestion` blocks for a11y patches against ONE file, ordered by severity. Returns markdown ready to post.
vs format_pr_comment: audit-level summary. vs generate_pr: opens the actual PR.

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description:
[schedule] Create a recurring audit on a cron schedule. Best for daily a11y regression checks, weekly competitor diffs, post-deploy smoke audits. Returns id + next_run_at.
Set alert_on_fail / alert_on_score_drop + score_threshold to trigger webhook_url + email_recipients alerts. Counts against monthly quota.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description:
[webhook] Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive audit event notifications (audit.completed, audit.failed, etc.). Outgoing requests are HMAC-SHA256-signed via your secret in `X-Vertaaux-Signature`. Returns id + active status.
URL must be HTTPS and externally reachable; SSRF-blocked URLs are rejected. Use list_webhooks first to avoid duplicates.

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: [schedule] DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete an audit schedule by ID; future runs are cancelled. Prefer update_schedule with enabled=false to pause without losing config. Look up ID via list_schedules.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: [webhook] DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete a webhook by ID; future events stop delivering. No soft-delete. Look up ID via list_webhooks.

tools.name: diff_a11y
tools.description:
[a11y] SECONDARY a11y diff using NAMED baselines (saved earlier via audit_a11y with baseline_name). Returns regressions + fixes + unchanged + net-change summary.
vs diff_audits: prefer that, works with any audit IDs, full 7-category coverage. Use diff_a11y only when you already have a named a11y baseline.

tools.name: diff_audits
tools.description:
[audit] PRIMARY diff tool, compare any two audits by ID. Returns new/fixed/regressed findings + per-category score deltas across 7 categories. Best for regression tracking, before/after deploy verification, CI delta reports.
Blocks cross-major engine version comparisons unless force_compare=true. vs compare_competitors: that runs fresh audits live.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: [session] Diagnostic on the MCP client's reachability to VertaaUX: auth, network, quota, engine availability. Never throws, every check degrades to ok:false with an error field.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: [findings] Deep-dive a specific finding by ID: returns element HTML, screenshot URL, WCAG criteria, user impact, repro steps, before/after fix code. Use after audit_url to expand on a finding from get_findings.

tools.name: explain_issue
tools.description:
[session] Format an INLINE audit issue object into developer-friendly guidance: WCAG explanation, user impact, code-level fix, canonical reference links. No network call.
vs explain_finding: that fetches by ID from the backend; this one takes the issue literal you already have.

tools.name: format_pr_comment
tools.description:
[pr] Render an AUDIT-LEVEL PR comment from an audit_id: overall score, category breakdown, top findings, optional baseline delta. Returns the same markdown the GitHub Action emits.
vs create_pr_comment: per-file patch suggestions. vs generate_pr: opens the actual PR.

tools.name: generate_patch
tools.description:
[fix] LEGACY issue-based fix generator (no framework detection). Returns search/replace patch + confidence + explanation.
vs suggest_fix (PREFERRED): framework-aware (React/Vue/Angular/Svelte), finding-based, JSX-idiomatic patches. Use generate_patch only for legacy job_id/issue_id consumers.

tools.name: generate_pr
tools.description:
[pr] OPENS a draft GitHub PR with N a11y patches applied ATOMICALLY via Git Trees (all-or-nothing commit). Refuses overlapping patches (CONFLICT) and unparseable JS/TS/JSX/Vue/Svelte (AST_INVALID via Babel/vue-eslint-parser/svelte/compiler gate).
Inputs from suggest_fix (preferred) or generate_patch (legacy). Requires GITHUB_TOKEN; without it, set local_only=true to get patch content. Always creates DRAFT, never auto-merges.

tools.name: generate_sarif
tools.description: [audit] Convert a VertaaUX audit into a SARIF 2.1.0 document for GitHub Code Scanning. Returns the sarif log + size warnings (never throws on oversize).

tools.name: get_audit
tools.description: [audit] Fetch the status and (when completed) results of an audit job by ID: status, progress 0-100, 7-category scores, issues array. Poll after audit_url/run_audit/run_llm_audit/audit_a11y with wait=false. Same ID namespace across all of them.

tools.name: get_engines
tools.description: [quota] List audit engine versions on this account: semver-tagged releases plus a 'latest' alias and per-version release notes. Use to pin audits for reproducible deltas or discover newer analyzers.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: [findings] Get findings from a completed audit with pagination + filtering by severity, rule, or change status. Use after audit_url/audit_repo/audit_artifact for detailed findings.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: [quota] Get the authenticated account's tier (free/pro), audits remaining in current billing window, reset timestamp, and feature flags. Call before batch audits to avoid mid-run quota errors.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: [schedule] Read full config of an audit schedule by ID: cron, target URL, audit mode, enabled, alerts (alert_on_fail / alert_on_score_drop + score_threshold), webhook_url, email_recipients, last/next_run_at. Look up ID via list_schedules.

tools.name: list_audits
tools.description: [audit] Paginate audit history newest-first: id, url, mode, status, created_at, completed_at, summary scores. Use status filter to find prior audit IDs as baseline_id for diff_audits / verify_fixes, or to find failed audits to investigate.

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: [schedule] List all audit schedules on the account: ID, target URL, cron, mode, enabled, alert config, next_run_at. Use before update_schedule or delete_schedule to look up the ID.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: [webhook] List webhooks on the account: ID, URL, subscribed event types (audit.completed, audit.failed, etc.), active status, last-delivery timestamp. Use before create_webhook (avoid duplicates) or delete_webhook (look up ID).

tools.name: policy_check
tools.description:
[audit] Evaluate a `vertaa.policy.yml` document against an audit and return pass/fail with structured violations. Mirrors the GitHub Action's threshold evaluator so CI and agent verdicts match exactly.
Policy keys (all optional): min_scores (overall + per-category), max_issues (per severity), required_rules, forbidden_rules, fail_fast. See README for full schema.

tools.name: run_audit
tools.description: [audit] DEPRECATED: use audit_url. Kept for legacy clients only.

tools.name: run_llm_audit
tools.description:
[audit] LLM-based UX audit of a URL via the VertaaUX provider-agnostic adapter (Mistral/OpenAI/etc.). Returns qualitative narrative on hero clarity, messaging, copy tone, conversion nudges, things rule-based audits miss.
vs audit_url: that's rule-based WCAG/a11y. Consumes LLM credits, separate from audit quota.

tools.name: run_verification_suite
tools.description:
[audit] PRE-deploy patch verification: test a proposed patch (search/replace + CSS selector) against a live URL in a sandboxed browser BEFORE you commit. Runs before/after axe-core, returns score delta + rule pass.
vs verify_fixes: that's POST-deploy URL-vs-baseline comparison; this is patch-vs-live in isolation.

tools.name: stream_findings
tools.description:
[findings] Page through findings of an ALREADY-COMPLETED audit as NDJSON without holding them in memory. Wait for audit.status='completed' first (returns 400 otherwise).
Caps memory at 100-item ring buffer, 120s hard timeout, respects AbortSignal. For live progress while audit runs, pass _meta.progressToken to audit_url.

tools.name: suggest_fix
tools.description:
[fix] PRIMARY framework-aware fix generator. Pass finding_id + audit_id to get an idiomatic search/replace patch (React/Next/Vue/Angular/Svelte/Nuxt detected via nearest package.json). Returns patch + confidence + framework_confidence + needs_human_review.
Single (default) or batch (multiple finding_ids). Pipe output into generate_pr or run_verification_suite. vs generate_patch: that's the legacy issue/job ID variant.

tools.name: triage_finding
tools.description: [findings] Set the triage state of a finding (open, in_progress, resolved, wont_fix) with an optional note.

tools.name: update_schedule
tools.description: [schedule] Partial update of an audit schedule (all fields except id are optional). Use list_schedules to look up ID. Common: pause via enabled=false, change cadence via cron_expression, add score-drop alerts.

tools.name: verify_fixes
tools.description:
[audit] POST-DEPLOY fix verification. Run a fresh audit on a URL where you merged a11y fixes and compare to a baseline. Partitions findings into: fixed (worked), still_broken (didn't land), regressions (worse), new_issues (unrelated), unknown (flaky, not counted).
Returns verification_status: all_fixed | partial | regressed | budget_exhausted | unknown. Budget-capped at 3 iterations per (session, baseline_audit_id). vs run_verification_suite: that's PRE-deploy patch-in-isolation testing.
